name: zmath_mat_rotate_y
description: zMath::MatRotateY applies a Y-axis rotation to the current matrix stack entry, including identity-stack materialization and composition with a non-identity current matrix.
known_limits: Tier B data is audited against the zMath current-matrix pointer and identity flag globals. Tier S byte verification remains blocked: VC5SP3 profile sweeps emit a 288-byte frameless separate fsin/fcos body, while retail is a 417-byte EBP-frame body with a compiler trig threshold and fsincos fallback.
